prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / character rigging anatomy reference.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the original character's bare bent arm and original hand holding an iced coffee cup. Its palm-to-forearm junction is visibly broken, not anatomically connected, and has a spare skin flap and overlapping diagonal contours.
Input image 2 is the ORIGINAL HAND AND CUP reference: preserve this exact finger pose, finger proportions, pale blue nails, coffee cup, lid, ice, drink and blue circular label. Do not design a replacement hand.

Create a corrected version of image 1 that shows how this existing coffee-holding hand naturally joins the forearm at the wrist. Change ONLY the short transition between the heel of the palm and the end of the forearm. Show one anatomically plausible short wrist, a smooth continuous skin surface, gently tapered wrist bones and two continuous outer contours. There must be no narrow rubber neck, no pasted skin band, no diagonal end cap, no extra skin flap, no doubled contour, no detached wrist, no line across the joint. The existing long internal line descending through the palm must end as a subtle short palm crease, not continue into a false second wrist edge.

Preserve the original fingers, nails, gripping gesture, cup and original forearm/elbow shape. Keep the layout and crop closely registered to image 1. If needed for anatomical alignment, move or rotate the hand and cup together as one rigid assembly by a small amount; do not stretch the forearm, elongate the wrist or redesign the hand. The forearm should feel like a solid natural limb, with only a modest bend at the wrist.

Precisely match the original anime illustration: very pale ivory skin, restrained soft pale pink shading with the SAME hue and lightness as the original forearm, and fine softly antialiased reddish brown contours with the SAME thickness as the original arm. Preserve the original delicate drawing style, resolution and color palette. No thick ink, bold cartoon outlines, photorealism, changed lighting, extra fingers, extra anatomy, gloves, bracelets, sleeves, text, diagrams or annotations.
Output a single high resolution cutout of the corrected arm, hand and cup on a truly transparent background. Keep all the reference canvas margins and full elbow and coffee cup in frame.
